name: Combine and Copy Files to Clipboard For AI and LLM
description:
Effortlessly merge and copy the content of multiple files into your clipboard, organized by their paths and relative filenames.
        Perfect for delivering crystal-clear context to AI models like OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude, empowering them to work smarter and faster!
preview: Effortlessly merge and copy the content of multiple files into your clipboard, organized by their paths and relative filenames. Perfect for delivering crystal-clear...
docText:
Right-Click: Select one or more files or a directory, then choose "Combine and Copy to Clipboard."
Editor Integration: Highlight text in your editor and click "Copy / Paste Special" → "Copy Text with Filename and Path to Clipboard."
Supercharge your workflow with effortless file merging and copying! Perfect for developers, AI enthusiasts, and content creators.
